title: ZestUp
oneLiner: A restaurant ordering and delivery platform so Pakistani restaurants can stop paying 30%+ commissions to aggregators like Foodpanda.
body: Lead Backend Developer and architect of the backend that serves all five clients. Designed the API, data model, auth/RBAC, real-time tracking, and multi-branch isolation so web, admin, and Flutter apps run on one reliable core.

caseStudy.situation: Restaurants needed delivery, pickup, dine-in, POS, and multi-branch management without aggregator fees — across web, admin, and rider/customer mobile apps.
caseStudy.task: As lead backend developer, architect a single backend serving 5 independent clients with consistent auth, real-time tracking, and branch-scoped data.
action: Built layered Express/TypeScript API: 22 feature modules (Controllers → Services → Repositories → DTOs) with tsyringe DI and Zod validation
Dual ORM data layer: Prisma for standard ops, Kysely for complex type-safe queries; soft-deletes + audit fields via Prisma extension
Real-time layer: 3 Socket.IO namespaces (admin/customer/rider) with Redis adapter; GPS streaming, route-deviation checks via Google Maps Routes API + Turf.js
Auth/RBAC: JWT auth for 3 user types, granular role-permission middleware, rate-limit + validation + exception chain
Domain model: Branch multi-tenancy with junction tables (BranchItem, BranchRider, BranchCoupon), OrderStatus lifecycle, coupons, POS orders, sales reconciliation
results: One backend serves React admin, React customer web, Flutter customer + rider apps
Live rider tracking with deviation alerts (>400m), FCM + Socket.IO notifications
Shipped POS, multi-branch management, roles/permissions, coupons, sales dashboard
Swagger + AsyncAPI docs, deployable via Docker Compose / Kinsta + Vercel

title: AgentsDesk
oneLiner: A multi-tenant AI support platform so companies can deploy isolated, tool-calling support agents per client.
body: Architected tenant isolation from the data layer up, so each customer's agent, tools, and conversation history stay fully separate on shared infrastructure.

caseStudy.situation: Businesses want AI chat + voice support on any website without rebuilding infra per client.
caseStudy.task: Build a B2B SaaS where orgs build a knowledge base, customize a widget, configure a VAPI voice agent — all from one dashboard — and embed via script tag.
action: Built Next.js dashboard + Convex backend with per-org knowledge bases and widget config
Embedded widget handles queries through RAG-based AI with seamless human escalation
Configured VAPI voice agents per org from the same dashboard
Tenant-scoped agents, tools, and conversation history on shared infra
results: Deploy anywhere via simple script embed
Chat + voice from one control plane

title: Swappin Numbers Academy
oneLiner: Subscription platform for financial literacy: books, courses, AI Buddy, credit-repair automation, and community.
body: Lead full-stack build from scratch in ~3 months: React + Firebase + GPT-4 AI Buddy, dispute-letter automation, real-time Frat House feed, tiered subscriptions with referrals and RBAC.

caseStudy.situation: Only ~57% of U.S. adults are financially literate. Client needed education + AI guidance + automated credit repair + community in one secure ecosystem handling sensitive financial data.
caseStudy.task: Architect and ship the entire platform production-ready in 3 months for thousands of concurrent users.
action: Scalable infra on React + Firebase (Auth, Firestore, Functions, Storage)
GPT-4 AI Buddy with context-aware assistance, history tracking, cost optimization
Dispute generation: analyze reports, produce customized letters, track status/timelines, secure doc storage
Realtime social feed (posts, media, likes, comments) with moderation, lazy-load + compression
Tiered subscriptions with RBAC, referral codes + commission dashboard, renewals + payments, admin panel
results: 5 core features shipped: AI Buddy, Credit Repair, Dispute Gen, Community, Referrals
85% reduction in manual intervention; <15% operational overhead
Realtime feed <500ms latency; WCAG 2.1 compliant; encrypted financial data

title: My Car Rental
oneLiner: Multi-country car rental booking with localization, multi-currency, and self-service portal.
body: Full-stack build with a team: Next.js frontend, NestJS modular API, Firebase Auth/Data/Storage. Location search, EN/RU translations, advance/deferred + Pay Later payments, license verification.

caseStudy.situation: Fragmented booking across countries: language barriers, inconsistent payments, manual document verification blocking expansion.
caseStudy.task: Unified platform with multi-language, multi-currency, secure license verification, and self-service portal.
action: Next.js SSR frontend for fast global loads + SEO; NestJS modular backend; Firebase BaaS
Location search by country/city/area with realtime availability and category filters
Currency conversion + localized pricing/tax; multi-currency transactions + receipts + Pay Later partial payments
Customer portal: rental lifecycle, license upload, history, modifications, downloadable agreements
results: Seamless localized booking; eliminated language barriers

title: NexManage
oneLiner: Operations platform with RBAC, payments, chapter management, and realtime analytics.
body: Lead systems architect for 850+ members across 12 chapters: Next.js + Node + MongoDB, 7 permission levels, Puppeteer PDF reports, WebSocket notifications, JWT + audit logging.

caseStudy.situation: 850+ members in spreadsheets + disconnected payment tools; 15-20 hrs/week admin, 48h+ inquiry response.
caseStudy.task: Consolidate into one secure scalable system in 3 months with 5+ user types and realtime financial tracking.
action: Modular Next.js + Node + MongoDB; 7-level RBAC with hierarchical chapters
Invoicing + reconciliation + Puppeteer PDF engine
Recharts dashboard for trends/revenue; WebSocket realtime notifications
JWT auth, encrypted storage, audit logging
results: Payment accuracy 94% → 99.7%; 97% adoption in 30 days; zero incidents

title: Pak Qurtaba
oneLiner: Visa/travel agency MIS with multi-role dashboards and automated CV generation.
body: Full-stack build: React + Appwrite Auth + RBAC for Admin/Applicant/Demand portals, server-side pagination for 5k+ records, group-based filtering, export-ready CVs in <30s.

caseStudy.situation: Manual paperwork, disorganized applicant tracking, no realtime visibility across stakeholders.
caseStudy.task: Digitize end-to-end workflow for hundreds of applicants with 3 secure portals and scalable data layer.
action: Three RBAC dashboards (Admin/Applicant/Demand) on Appwrite Auth with data isolation
Applicant profiles + reference linking + demand workflow; server-side pagination for 1k+ filtered rows
Dynamic key-value group filtering + custom search (<800ms)
Auto CV generation + bulk export + status/demand analytics
results: 70% less admin work; 60% fewer status calls; reports in minutes
5k+ records, <2s dashboard load, centralized decision-ready data
